node.statement: Closed-corner completeness in the inherited norm: the extended epsilon-C*-algebra A in def-hcb-datum is complete.  For its corresponding compressed corner, Co_{P,Q} is the bounded compression idempotent on A and S_{P,Q}=Img(Co_{P,Q})=Ker(I-Co_{P,Q}).  Since I-Co_{P,Q} is continuous, its kernel is closed in A; a closed subspace of the Banach space A is Banach, so S_{P,Q} is complete in the inherited norm.
